title: GTA 6 Already Made $1.65 Billion (Estimate)
short_description: GTA 6 has sold about 17 million digital copies, worth over $1.65 billion, according to Sensor Tower estimates reported by Reuters, Fox Business and Adweek. Around 3 in 4 were on PS5. These are third-party estimates: Rockstar and Take-Two haven't shared official numbers yet, but Take-Two's CEO said presales ran 'far in excess' of expectations (Variety). #ViceReplayBreaking

short.headline: $1.65 BILLION
short.text: GTA 6 has already made over one point six billion dollars, and it only just came out.
short.text_es: GTA 6 ya ganó más de mil seiscientos millones de dólares, y acaba de salir.

short.headline: 17 MILLION COPIES
short.text: Analytics firm Sensor Tower estimates about seventeen million copies sold, and that's digital only, no discs counted.
short.text_es: La firma Sensor Tower estima unos diecisiete millones de copias vendidas, y solo digitales, sin contar las físicas.

short.headline: 3 IN 4 ON PS5
short.text: Around three out of four of those copies were on PS5, according to the same estimates.
short.text_es: Cerca de tres de cada cuatro copias fueron en PS5, según las mismas estimaciones.

short.headline: NOT OFFICIAL YET
short.text: Rockstar hasn't shared official numbers yet, but Take-Two's boss said presales were far beyond expectations.
short.text_es: Rockstar aún no da cifras oficiales, pero el jefe de Take-Two dijo que las preventas superaron por mucho lo esperado.

short.headline: ARE YOU ONE?
short.text: Are you one of the seventeen million? Tell me below, because
